messages:
lina: PSA - veridian-v1-int8 onboarding smoke flagged emoji + CJK splits. repro on zh->en and ja->en, punctuation getting detached.
hao: paste a sample?
lina: ```
INPUT: "👋🏽 🇨🇳👨🏿‍💬いま日本。"
TOKENIZER: ["👋", "🏽", " ", "🇨🇳", "👨", "🏿", "\u200d", "‍💬", "いま", "日本", "。"]
EXPECTED: ["👋🏽", " ", "🇨🇳👨🏿‍💬", "いま日本", "。"]
OBS: VARIATION SELECTOR/ZWJ pieces split into separate tokens, causing translation drop.
```
qa-bot: run=rloc-1130, model=veridian-v1-int8, dataset=emoji-locale-smoke, metrics={bleu:-0.45, sacrebleu:-0.47}, anomalies={split_variation_selectors:14, zwj_breaks:9}
sam: looks like the pre-token strip recently added is removing/normalizing VS16 or collapsing regional-indicator adjacency. did we change that sanitizer?
hao: yep I tweaked nonprint strip to be more aggressive (tighten control bytes). apparently it treats VS16 (U+FE0F) and ZWJ combos as separate now when skin-tones present.
lina: quick mitigation: revert the aggressive strip and re-run smoke -> BLEU recovered to -0.08 on small set. recommend staging rollback.
ops: rolling back canary for veridian-v1-int8 now, incident I-2026-79 created.
hao: i'll open a patch to restore keeping VS16 + regional-indicator adjacency checks and add sanitizer to reject raw control bytes (U+001F etc). PR: https://git.internal/tokenizer/pr/4688 (draft).
sam: long-term: add mixed CJK+emoji unit in locale-suite and histogram-based token-id drift checks between fp16 and int8 (sentence-level threshold 2%). i'll own tests. :rocket:
qa-bot: note: when strip reverted, rerun=rloc-1131 metrics={bleu:-0.09, sacrebleu:-0.12}, full eval pending.
lina: thanks all. will attach failing samples to ticket and track fix.
summary: Onboarding int8 for veridian-v1 exposed emoji + CJK token splits due to an aggressive sanitizer change; short-term rollback improved BLEU; next steps: revert sanitizer, add VS16/ZWJ checks, new locale-suite tests and token-id drift monitoring
